proof_body:
by
  intro V _ _ a b hli x y
  rw [mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply] at hr
    simp only [vsub_eq_sub, vadd_eq_add] at hr
    have h0 : (x - (1 - r)) • a + (y - r) • b = 0 := by
      linear_combination (norm := module) (-1 : ℝ) • hr
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := LinearIndependent.pair_iff.mp hli _ _ h0
    linarith
  · intro h
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply]
    simp only [vsub_eq_sub, vadd_eq_add]
    have hx : x = 1 - y := by linarith
    rw [hx]; module
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (a b : V), LinearIndependent ℝ ![a, b] → ∀ x y : ℝ, (x • a + y • b ∈ affineSpan ℝ ({a, b} : Set V) ↔ x + y = 1)
